id.description: Unique identifier for the logical object that instance of this type represents.

name.description: The name of the component. Optional field for informational purposes only.

dataSpec.description: The specification used for retrieving data displayed by the map.

disableDataRequestOnFirstRender.description: Disable if you want to avoid sending any and all requests for this component on first render.

triggersRegistered.description: Whether the effect triggers and epics have been registered

wrapWithMetadataId.description: Whether to wrap the component with a div which has a class name of its metdata id. Useful for targeting with css.

height.description: The height of the component in pixels.

markerData.description: The data for markers to display on the map.

layers.description:
The data for layers to display on the map.
The {@link UiSdlMapLayer#name} is used to ensure that layers create sources with unique ids.
The layer index will be concatenated to the name before passing through for rendering.

defaultMarkerColor.description: The default color that will be used for markers on the map.

defaultMarkerShape.description: The default shape that will be used for markers on the map.

mapStyle.description: The style of the background map tiles.

hideControls.description: Whether or not to hide the navigation and full screen control within the map.

legend.description: Map Legend - information for coloring of markers.

centering.description: Centering - configuration for the center button displayed on the map.

zoom.description:
Zoom Type of the Map.
{@link UiSdlMapFixedZoom} (developer provides exact zoom level),
{@link UiSdlMapAutoZoom} (default option, based on plotted data)

transitionDuration.description: Transition duration is required to zoom in on markers on first render (in ms).

title: The react component type of {@link UiSdlMap}.
name: UiSdlMapReact
